note: Adapted from the original description by Hill (1927), in English; the soldier and the worker are included. The soldier measurement table is badly damaged in the scan (head length and width, mandible and tibia values cannot be read), so only the body length that can be confirmed is retained; for the worker only the legible values are taken. The type locality is 30 miles south-east of Port Moresby, Papua.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Anterior part of the head darkest, Sanford's brown; anteclypeus transparent, labrum orange-yellow, mandibles dark reddish brown to nearly black, the rest milky white. Head slightly elongate, the sides rounded, the back rounded, with sparse medium-sized pale red setae, most numerous on the postclypeus. Mandibles relatively short and stout, finely toothed from the base outwards towards the apex, each mandible with a distinct tooth at the base. Anteclypeus short, its anterior margin projecting in the middle; labrum large and wide, with several large setae at the apex. Antennae short and stout, 13-segmented, segment 3 distinctly the shortest and narrowest, segments 4 and 5 equal in length and bead-like. Pronotum narrow, the anterior margin raised, rounded in front and not concave, the anterior lateral corners rather projecting, the posterior margin broadly rounded without a concavity, with sparse medium-length stout hairs, one long hair on each side near the anterior lateral corners; mesonotum slightly narrower than the pronotum, its posterior margin less rounded, fringed with sparse medium stout hairs. Legs short and stout, with few pale hairs. Body length 4.00 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head pale yellowish brown, with dark red spots at the mandibular articulation, the rest nearly white. Head nearly hemispherical, flattened behind the postclypeus; postclypeus large and swollen, straight in front and convex behind, with a distinct median suture; anteclypeus long, shaped as in the soldier; labrum large and swollen, widest in the middle, rounded in front. Antennae short and stout, 13-segmented, segment 3 the shortest and narrowest. Pronotum as in the soldier but with paler and finer hairs; legs as in the soldier. Abdomen long and slender, with sparse, pale, short hairs. Measurements: body length 3.64, head length (to the frontoclypeal suture) 0.68, pronotum width 0.40 mm.
